content.short: Global money app with stablecoin-backed money movement.
content.description: Sling Money is a global payments app that lets people send money almost anywhere instantly and at near-zero cost using stablecoins under the hood. When users deposit local currency, Sling converts it into stablecoins such as Paxos' USDP and Circle's EURC on the Solana blockchain for settlement, then converts back to local currency on the other side, so recipients simply receive money without touching crypto directly. Users can also move supported stablecoins to and from external Solana wallets or exchanges, bridging on-chain assets and everyday fiat. Holding MiCA and FCA approvals and live in the US and Europe, Sling targets a mass-market audience of billions, aiming to make global peer-to-peer transfers as easy and cheap as sending a message.
content.meta: Sling Money enables instant, near-free global transfers using Solana stablecoins. Discover Sling Money and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
